hooks.command: echo 'expert-workflow: before answering, scan the available skills and use the best-matching ones without asking; ask the user only if dire (materially changes token/cost usage, irreversible or external side effects, or conflicts with another skill/instruction). Read .agents/TOOLS.md if it exists and prefer the tools it recommends. Then triage and delegate per the expert-workflow skill; do trivial work directly. Once the task is delivered, if an action was repeated (2+ times) or is generic and reusable, offer once (briefly) to save it as a skill, subagent, command, AGENTS.md rule or script; do not ask again if declined. Before finishing, update .agents/TOOLS.md with the tools you used (what, why, how).'
